lines.en: Well, my boyfriend might not be moving back for a while,
so I have to back out.
Just wanted to look at it one more time.
You know, I can't give you your deposit back.
All right, Martha. I get it.
Actually, is there a way I could put down, like, a...
I didn't know you were coming back here.
Oh, my God, what are you doing?
I am deeply, ridiculously in love with you.
And above everything else, I just...
I want to be with you forever.
I need to remember this. - Sure.
- Leslie, no... - No, no, no, no, no. Hold on.
Just... I need another second, please.
about how perfect my life is right now.
